research.title: Paraphrase Robustness in Natural Language Inference
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare inference models on meaning-preserving paraphrases, controlling for sentence length and lexical overlap.
Implemented evaluation routines and reviewed prediction changes across negation, modifier placement, and syntactic variation to distinguish annotation ambiguity from model errors.

research.title: Intent Classification Under Class Imbalance
bullets: Planned experiments with supervisor guidance comparing class weighting and resampling for intent classification, using stratified splits and per-class evaluation.
Evaluated temperature scaling on held-out validation data and examined confidence patterns for rare intents, ambiguous requests, and frequently confused intent pairs.

publications.title: Class Imbalance and Confidence Calibration in Intent Classification

work.title: Inventory and Order Coordination
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded discrepancies, and organized supplies in designated storage areas for routine operational use.
Prepared order paperwork, maintained filing records, and coordinated pickup schedules with staff while communicating missing items and delivery changes.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Named Entity Taggers
bullets: Implemented conditional random field and bidirectional recurrent tagging baselines using consistent tokenization, label conventions, and training partitions for entity recognition.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, inspecting boundary errors and confusion between entity categories across short and long sentences.

projects.title: Lexical and Dense Retrieval for Question Matching
bullets: Implemented lexical ranking and pretrained sentence embedding retrieval for matching questions to relevant answers within a fixed document collection.
Compared ranking quality using shared relevance labels and inspected retrieval failures involving paraphrases, uncommon terminology, and questions with overlapping keywords.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Redundancy Control
bullets: Implemented frequency-based sentence scoring and graph-based ranking for extractive summarization, applying identical preprocessing and summary length constraints across methods.
Compared reference overlap and manually reviewed topic coverage, sentence redundancy, and missing context under alternative sentence selection and redundancy penalties.
